text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: It was no good after all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I have someone's back I'm aiming for, 
so I don't have time to dawdle, and 
yet..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Someone like me really can't...!
choice_data_list: I'll keep cheering you on, always!

Are you giving up on chasing the back of 
the one you admire?

text_block_list.text: Ugh... Someone like me really can't...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
W-Why...? Don't you feel like giving up on 
me...?
choice_data_list:
...Because I know what you've been keeping 
in your heart!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Right... I'm still in the middle of a long 
journey. If I let myself feel down, I'll 
never reach the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll try even harder in the next race. 
Even if it's one step at a time, I have to 
keep moving forward...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I can't give up. Not over something 
like this, never...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I'll head back and review the race. 
Starting tomorrow again... I'll be in your 
care...!
